note: Sample prompts that map to the three Seagate issues: (1) content is scattered and inconsistently labelled, (2) source permissions do not match the approved audience, (3) decisions live in email, where AI cannot reach them. Each intent must match an id in agent.json.

placeholders.{userUpn}: Replaced with the UPN found in the question, or with the caller's UPN when none is given.

prompts.issueLabel: 1. Content is scattered and inconsistently labelled
